scenarios.name: resave_unchanged
scenarios.doc: What the entry's GET answered, posted back: the whole file is written again in HA's style and the posted entry's keys in HA's order; nothing is reloaded but the event fires.
scenarios.file:
- id: kitchen_off
  alias: Kitchen lights - off at 11:30pm
  description: Turn off the kitchen light and lamp every night at 11:30pm.
  mode: single
  triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "23:30:00"
  actions:
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id:
      - light.kitchen
      - light.lamp
    data:
      transition: 10
- id: hall_motion
  alias: Hallway lights - motion on when dark
  description: Turn on hallway lights when motion is detected below 30 lux, using dim overnight and gentle morning levels.
  mode: restart
  triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.hall_motion
    to: "on"
  conditions:
  - condition: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.hall_illuminance
    below: 30
  - condition: time
    after: "06:30:00"
    before: "23:00:00"
  actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.hall
    data:
      brightness_pct: 60
